dogecoin.text: FWIW, every time there’s been a planned special event for $doge, it precipitates a huge dump as whales ‘buy the rumor and sell the news’. The SNL dip is expected, and being this low means a good time to buy in. We went from the .40s to .19 before and rocketed past it again. Hold.
Jealous of all the homies who just bought more $doge on its dip to .25 before it shot back up to its proper floor of .30-40
